title: Build the Language Label and Values

lessons.title: ਭ (bha) — one new base for the next label

needs: a pen and something to write on
your eyes, for letter shapes on the page
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on and your eyes, for letter shapes on the page. You can listen to everything else now — leave the section called Script — one tiny step until you have stopped, and I will say so again when we reach it.

segments.text: Keep only the familiar long-vowel mark ਾ in view. Today adds one base letter.
Trace ਭ slowly once, then once more. Say bha. Do not attach a vowel mark yet.
Complete one careful attempt. Compare only the new shape or word, repair one difference, and stop.
No later answer in this lesson adds a new spelling.

segments.prompt: Which new Gurmukhi base letter did you trace for bha?

feedback.correct: ਭ is the new base; stop after this one shape.
feedback.incorrect: ਭ is the new base; stop after this one shape.

segments.text: Point once to ਭ (bha), then put it away. This session adds only ਸ਼ (sha).
Trace ਸ਼ (sha) once. Its dot belongs to the letter. Compare it with familiar ਸ, then cover the comparison.
Complete one careful attempt. Compare only the new shape or word, repair one difference, and stop.
No later answer in this lesson adds a new spelling.

segments.prompt: Type the new Gurmukhi letter for sha.

feedback.correct: ਸ਼ is sha; keep its dot with the letter.
feedback.incorrect: ਸ਼ is sha; keep its dot with the letter.

segments.text: Touch the two new bases in order: ਭ (bha), then ਸ਼ (sha). The long-vowel mark is already familiar.
Build ਭਾ + ਸ਼ਾ = ਭਾਸ਼ਾ (bhāshā). On a form, ਭਾਸ਼ਾ (bhāshā) asks which language belongs on the line. Copy the label once, then leave the answer line empty.
Complete one careful attempt. Compare only the new shape or word, repair one difference, and stop.
No later answer in this lesson adds a new spelling.

segments.prompt: A form shows ਭਾਸ਼ਾ (bhāshā). What information belongs on that line?

needs: a pen and something to write on
your eyes, for letter shapes on the page
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on and your eyes, for letter shapes on the page. You can listen to everything else now — leave the section called Script — one tiny step until you have stopped, and I will say so again when we reach it.

segments.text: Read ਭਾਸ਼ਾ (bhāshā) as language. Now hide it; this session adds one value-letter.
Trace ਪ once, say pa, and stop. The complete language name comes later.
Complete one careful attempt. Compare only the new shape or word, repair one difference, and stop.
No later answer in this lesson adds a new spelling.

segments.prompt: Type the Gurmukhi base letter pa.

feedback.correct: ਪ is pa, the first base in ਪੰਜਾਬੀ.
feedback.incorrect: ਪ is pa, the first base in ਪੰਜਾਬੀ.

lessons.title: ੰ (tippi) — the nasal mark inside ਪੰਜਾਬੀ (panjābī)
lessons.gloss: place tippi above a base letter

needs: a pen and something to write on
your eyes, for letter shapes on the page
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on and your eyes, for letter shapes on the page. You can listen to everything else now — leave the section called Script — one tiny step until you have stopped, and I will say so again when we reach it.

segments.text: Write ਪ (pa) once. Today adds only the nasal mark that sits above it.
Place ੰ (tippi) above ਪ (pa) to make ਪੰ. This is ṭippī, not the final-position bindi from ਹਾਂ.
Complete one careful attempt. Compare only the new shape or word, repair one difference, and stop.
No later answer in this lesson adds a new spelling.

segments.prompt: Which mark sits above ਪ (pa) in ਪੰ?

feedback.correct: ੰ is tippi; it sits above the base.
feedback.incorrect: ੰ is tippi; it sits above the base.

lessons.title: ਪੰਜਾਬੀ (panjābī) — the Punjabi value
lessons.gloss: assemble and guided-copy Punjabi as a form value

needs: a pen and something to write on
your eyes, for letter shapes on the page
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on and your eyes, for letter shapes on the page. You can listen to everything else now — leave the section called Script — one tiny step until you have stopped, and I will say so again when we reach it.

segments.text: Touch the pieces without writing: ਪੰ, ਜਾ, ਬੀ.
Assemble ਪੰਜਾਬੀ (panjābī) and copy it once with the model visible. This supported copy teaches the value; it is not independent writing evidence.
Complete one careful attempt. Compare only the new shape or word, repair one difference, and stop.
No later answer in this lesson adds a new spelling.

segments.prompt: With the model visible, copy the Punjabi value.

feedback.correct: ਪੰਜਾਬੀ is the Punjabi value; check ਪੰ, then ਜਾ, then ਬੀ.
feedback.incorrect: ਪੰਜਾਬੀ is the Punjabi value; check ਪੰ, then ਜਾ, then ਬੀ.

lessons.title: ਿ (sihari) — a mark written before, read after

segments.text: Write familiar ਹ once.

segments.prompt: Type the short-i mark used in ਹਿ.

lessons.title: ਹਿੰਦੀ (hindī) — the Hindi value
lessons.gloss: assemble and guided-copy Hindi as a form value

needs: a pen and something to write on
your eyes, for letter shapes on the page
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your hands, so it is not a driving lesson. You will want a pen and something to write on and your eyes, for letter shapes on the page. You can listen to everything else now — leave the section called Script — one tiny step until you have stopped, and I will say so again when we reach it.

segments.text: Point once to ਭਾਸ਼ਾ (bhāshā) and say language. Point once to ਪੰਜਾਬੀ (panjābī) and say Punjabi. Touch ਭ (bha), ਸ਼ (sha), then the pieces of the Hindi value: ਹਿ, ਂ, ਦੀ.
Assemble ਹਿੰਦੀ (hindī) and copy it once with the model visible. Keep the tippi above the first unit and the long ੀ on ਦ (da).
Complete one careful attempt. Compare only the new shape or word, repair one difference, and stop.
No later answer in this lesson adds a new spelling.

segments.prompt: With the model visible, copy the Hindi value.

feedback.correct: ਹਿੰਦੀ is the Hindi value; check ਹਿ, then tippi, then ਦੀ.
feedback.incorrect: ਹਿੰਦੀ is the Hindi value; check ਹਿ, then tippi, then ਦੀ.
